text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
We'd like to ask our super talented lineup 
about their race reflections and more. 
First off—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For me, the races so far were merely the 
overture. At the same time, it means the 
die has been cast!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, behold! Marching across the 
battlefield like Caesar... I shall 
demonstrate the 'Supreme Overlord's' 
majesty to the masses!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: So you're all fired up! I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us hear next from Zenno Rob 
Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...! U-U-Um...!! W-What kind of things 
should I talk about...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah, don't be so nervous. Please, relax.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
According to the materials, Robroy-san 
admires the hero Rob Roy, if I recall... 
Could you tell us more about—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you know about him!? Rob Roy, the 
Scottish hero!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I share my name with a hero 
who stood up for the weak, and I want to 
run races worthy of that name...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, when it comes to Rob Roy, I really 
love the novel that shaped the image we 
have today. Among all the heroic tales, 
especially—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, getting into the groove now!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Opera O! Why am I Opera O!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The answer to this eternal question. I 
kept confronting myself, and at last, I 
have found a ray of light!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
While real-life heroes and storybook 
heroes certainly diverge in some aspects, 
if we were to fill in parts of history 
with imagination—

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
This is... a torrential storm of 
information that would leave even Prince 
Shotoku stunned...!

Between Reporter Otonashi's sharp skills 
and the Umamusume's feelings, it turned 
out to be an intensely passionate 
interview article!
